schemaAuthority: C01-v1 image roles/color + retained native media fields; no new table, column or write authority

codec.inputs: Only binary PNG/JPEG/WEBP, detected format must equal declared supported MIME. Metadata alone is insufficient: fully decode bounded pixels before success. Original bytes remain unchanged; thumbnail separate. Reject animated/multi-page input explicitly, no implicit first-frame flattening.
codec.thumbnail: Auto-orient derived thumbnail, fit inside320x320 without enlargement, WEBP quality80; fresh SHA/size/MIME and originalSHA binding. Do not alter original.
codec.cancellation: Check AbortSignal before/after awaits; destroy codec on abort and bounded timeout, do not return stage on aborted/late completion. A timeout/error is failure, never metadata-only success.

stage.configuration: Explicit canonical private root outside public/static/dist and actual host current identity authorization callback; no default root, auto root discovery or browser source path. Test only scoped synthetic private fixture roots.
binding: productId actual EDIT or explicit CREATE-draft null
stage.authorization: Fresh actual ADMIN/WAREHOUSE create/edit scope authorization before upload and before root-command consumption; URL/UUID alone not authority. Storage provider never infers grants from input role or boolean.
stage.idempotency: Same exact actor+command+uploadKey+scope+bytes returns existing stage; changed scope/content under same key409. Atomic exclusive immutable manifests and files, mode0700dirs/0600files, fsync before stage success. Concurrent same-key cannot produce two visible committed stages.
stage.consumption: Root CREATE/EDIT passes original actor/scope/requestKey; before mutation re-read nofollow private manifest/original/thumb, exact digest/size/MIME/expiry and original-derived binding. Supply immutable prepared image facts to D1 same-client audit/receipt transaction. New native image UUID is not upload UUID unless explicitly created by native ID source.
stage.retention: No cleanup/delete on cancel/save failure/unknown COMMIT/expiry; replaced originals retained. No credentials or business payload in public output. Actual host manifest producer and delivery mapping must consume these exact prepared facts.

wireActivation.routeVersion: Existing product V2 routes only; no new route/version or DB fields.
wireActivation.oldCommands: Existing exact V2 shape without imageChanges keeps original parse/output/hash and replay/recovery behavior. Never synthesize imageChanges:[] for a pre-existing original key.
wireActivation.newCommands: New media-aware CREATE/EDIT exact extended shape requires imageChanges array, [] explicit no image edit. New client activates only with explicit stage and command capabilities; reserves original requestKey before upload and before send.
wireActivation.conflict: Same original key with changed old/new shape or imageChanges conflicts; no command hash regeneration or implicit key replacement. Receipt lookup/recovery precedes adoption/retry as existing contract.
wireActivation.saveGate: Missing stage/codec/actual schema22+/D1 prepared-image capability fails before mutation. A staged upload does not imply product save. Original receipt four keys and one product operation/version remain.

owners.D2: Codec/stage plus existing product parser/ports/service/store+tests within registered bounds; no package/lock edits
owners.D1: Actual runtime composition/private manifests + original same-client prepared images closure/ACL; production gate C only
owners.F2: After frozen writer/client contract, explicit media-aware UI capability; no autonomous activation
owners.C: Exact dependency/lock, storage/root provenance, targeted isolated runtime/PG/build/release
